svg.title: Systems-Level Architecture and Dynamics
svg.desc: The brain as interacting systems. Sensory areas feed dorsal and ventral streams; limbic structures such as the amygdala and cingulate tag what matters; the hippocampus binds and replays episodes; a semantic hub in the anterior temporal lobe links modality-specific spokes; control loops run through the basal ganglia, thalamus and cerebellum alongside prefrontal and parietal control networks; and a left frontotemporal network supports language. Organizing principles include streams, loops, gradients and timescales, hubs and rich clubs, and large-scale networks.
